During the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], '''one''' of the oldest [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]] in [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]&mdash;reportedly millennial old&mdash;was dying, and eventually someone was sent to examine its rings and learn through them the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] history.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Wroshyr Tree's Tale}}</ref>
